test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following countries will host the BWF para badminton championship in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thailand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **BWF Para Badminton Championship 2023** held in** Pattaya, Thailand.**
 
• It was organized from **9th May 2023 to 14th May 2023.**
 
• This was the 14th edition of the BWF Para Badminton Championship.
 
• **India's** parathletes have won 16 medals total, **four of which are gold.**
 
• **Gold** medals were won by **Pramod Bhagat**, **Suhas** in singles and **Krishna Nagar-Shivraj**, and **Pramod Bhagat-Sukant Kadam** in doubles.
 
• Silver was won by Nityasre, Tulsimathi, and Sukant Kadam in singles, and by Nityasre and Rachana Patel in doubles. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **BWF hosts** the **Para-Badminton World Championships**, a separate biannual competition.
 
• Five divisions and six sport classes are used to fight for the top para-badminton players.
 
• In June 2011, the Para Badminton World Federation (PBWF) opted to merge with the BWF, and therefore the championships were conducted under its management.
 
• The BWF Para Badminton Championship's **13th edition** took place in **Tokyo, Japan**, from November 1–6, 2022.
